name: University of Rochester
header:
University of Rochester
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Published math application page still explicitly refers to Fall 2026.
• English waiver requires an email request.
• Stipend quoted is 9 months; summer support is competitive.
• The research-area page includes instructional faculty and historical names. Amanda Tucker and Minsik Han
have instruction appointments; do not infer ordinary PhD-adviser availability. Steve Gonek is emeritus. Main
arithmetic-geometry contacts verified here are Thomas Tucker, Rivera-Letelier and Thakur.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
• Rochester directory and research-area list retain Jochnowitz. No authoritative death/retirement notice found,
but persistent faculty pages do not establish 2027 supervision. Do not label the 1994 article recent.
• No authoritative death notice found. Do not infer living/active adviser status solely from a persistent profile,
nor infer death or retirement from age or publication age.
• Do not mistake 2026 Rochester repository student theses listing him as Thesis Advisor for papers authored
by him. This 2026 arXiv entry is research notes with uncertain original manuscript date.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
May apply before finishing bachelor's if completed before matriculation. UChicago math meets degree-type
eligibility. Department expects proof maturity, algebra, linear algebra and rigorous analysis. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Request English waiver by email; arrange three referees, complete draft documents before requesting fee
waiver. Prior adviser agreement not required. [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No PhD program requires securing adviser before applying/admission. Outreach to relevant faculty
encouraged; math program: gradprogram@math.rochester.edu. [s1] [s3]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
apply.grad.rochester.edu, linked from official math page. Public FAQ covers referee upload and additional
documents. [s1] [s3]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
Official math page has not explicitly rolled forward from Fall 2026.2027 deadline, stipend and tests must be
confirmed. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
General school accepts TOEFL/iBT Home, IELTS, Duolingo. Department old page states TOEFL 100 with
speaking 21. Two-year validity at application deadline. Ask for updated TOEFL-scale math minimum if testing is
needed. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Possible after at least 3 years full-time in-person postsecondary study in US/eligible country. Email
graduate.admissions@rochester.edu to request; university may still require proof. [s2]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Department checklist says GRE scores but only explicitly discusses optional math subject test. General-test
status is unclear; obtain confirmation. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Prior cycle]
Strongly encouraged, not required, on department page currently carrying Fall 2026 date. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Math page currently states USD 26,000 for 9 months of TA service, about 10 hours/week, plus tuition waiver
and mandatory health fee. Summer teaching roughly USD 5,000 competitively available. Page is not a verified
2027 rate; do not treat summer as guaranteed. [s1]
Years of support [Prior cycle]
Department states at least 4 years in good standing; fifth year typically available with satisfactory
progress.2027 contract controls. [s1]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department explicitly describes incoming foreign students receiving stipend while initially assigned grading
pending spoken-English evaluation. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Good standing/progress and assigned TA/grading service; teaching duties depend on spoken-English
evaluation. [s1]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Department awards merit support during admission; no separate application established. [s4]
Other funding routes [Prior cycle]
Competitive summer teaching and adviser summer research fellowships; advanced Dean's Teaching
Fellowships also described, with dated/undated amounts requiring confirmation. [s1]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
USD 70 nonrefundable on department page carrying Fall 2026 date; verify current portal. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Request in application; central FAQ says case-by-case after all required materials are complete, via
departmental coordinator. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Thomas Tucker
Arithmetic dynamics, Diophantine geometry and number theory; recent work tests eventual stability over
number fields. [faculty1] [faculty1a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · A Counterexample to the Eventual Stability Conjecture
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Juan Rivera-Letelier
Arithmetic and complex/non-Archimedean dynamics; recent work on Hecke correspondences on modular
curves over complex and p-adic fields. [faculty3] [faculty3a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Statistical properties of Hecke correspondences
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

Number theory
Dinesh Thakur
Function-field arithmetic, Drinfeld-module and zeta-value questions, Diophantine approximation; recent listed
work also studies prime-polynomial distributions and arithmetic dynamics. [faculty5] [faculty5a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Four Digit Kaprekar Dynamics in Odd Bases
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Naomi Jochnowitz
Algebraic number theory, modular and p-adic modular forms, Hecke-algebra congruences and derivatives of
L-series. [faculty8] [gapc1] [gapc2] [gapc3] [gapc4]
Currently listed by Rochester as Associate Professor of Mathematics. Current advising availability and a recent original paper
remain unverified.
Research evidence: 1994 · A p-adic conjecture about derivatives of L-series attached to modular forms
Older proceedings article, Contemporary Mathematics 165, 239-263. Bibliographic details independently preserved by
Dalhousie's mathematical bibliography; AMS proceedings endmatter corroborates her contribution. No recent original publication
verified.
Research evidence: 1982 · Congruences between systems of eigenvalues of modular forms
AMS publisher's indexed volume contents corroborate title and authorship; direct publisher request returned 403 in this
environment.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier interests: Official profile lists algebraic number theory and modular/p-adic modular forms. No recent research
paper verified on the official profile or institutional searches; current project fit requires confirmation.
Earlier appointment: Official profile: Associate Professor. Recent research activity and new PhD supervision unconfirmed.
Evidence qualifications
Rochester directory and research-area list retain Jochnowitz. No authoritative death/retirement notice found, but persistent
faculty pages do not establish 2027 supervision. Do not label the 1994 article recent.
Algebra / topology / representation-theory connections
Jonathan Pakianathan
Group and Lie-algebra cohomology, modular representation connections, braid groups, configuration spaces
and discrete geometry. [faculty7] [gapc41] [gapc42] [gapc43]
Professor in Rochester's current directory.
Research evidence: 2022; newer paper not verified on official profile · Random gap processes and asymptotically complete
sequences
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Research evidence: 2026 repository submission; manuscript age uncertain · Configuration Spaces and Braid Groups
Fred Cohen and Jonathan Pakianathan; primary arXiv search index gives June 15, 2026. An undated institutional manuscript with
the same title exists. Treat 2026 as repository-release date, not proof the underlying work was written in 2026. Full arXiv
retrieval was disabled; institutional PDF retrieval timed out.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier group: Representation theory
Earlier interests: Adjacent fit: cohomology of groups and Lie algebras, algebraic topology, and discrete geometry; latest
selected publication shown is a probability/additive-sequence paper, not evidence of a current representation-theory
project.
Earlier appointment: Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.

Evidence qualifications
Do not mistake 2026 Rochester repository student theses listing him as Thesis Advisor for papers authored by him. This 2026
arXiv entry is research notes with uncertain original manuscript date.
Algebraic geometry / homological algebra
Saul Lubkin
p-adic cohomology, commutative and homological algebra, topological-module completions and algebraic
topology. [faculty9] [gapc5] [gapc6] [gapc7] [gapc8]
Currently listed as Professor of Mathematics by Rochester. Recent research activity and 2027 supervision are unverified.
Research evidence: 2015 research monograph · A Non-Hausdorff Completion: The Abelian Category of C-complete Left
Modules over a Topological Ring
A research monograph, not a recent article. Publisher-supplied Google Books listing confirms May 2015 and Rochester affiliation.
Direct World Scientific request returned403.
Research evidence: 1977 · Generalization of p-adic cohomology; bounded Witt vectors. A canonical lifting of a variety in
characteristic p ≠ 0 back to characteristic zero
Original article archived by Numdam; explicitly historical evidence, not evidence of current activity.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier group: Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Earlier interests: Official profile lists algebraic geometry, homological and commutative algebra, and algebraic topology.
Official search surfaced historical publications only; no recent paper verified.
Earlier appointment: Official profile says Professor, not emeritus; current research activity and new PhD supervision
require explicit confirmation.
Evidence qualifications
No authoritative death notice found. Do not infer living/active adviser status solely from a persistent profile, nor infer death or
retirement from age or publication age.

University of Rochester
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Published math application page still explicitly refers to Fall 2026.
• English waiver requires an email request.
• Stipend quoted is 9 months; summer support is competitive.
• The research-area page includes instructional faculty and historical names. Amanda Tucker and Minsik Han
have instruction appointments; do not infer ordinary PhD-adviser availability. Steve Gonek is emeritus. Main
arithmetic-geometry contacts verified here are Thomas Tucker, Rivera-Letelier and Thakur.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
• Rochester directory and research-area list retain Jochnowitz. No authoritative death/retirement notice found,
but persistent faculty pages do not establish 2027 supervision. Do not label the 1994 article recent.
• No authoritative death notice found. Do not infer living/active adviser status solely from a persistent profile,
nor infer death or retirement from age or publication age.
• Do not mistake 2026 Rochester repository student theses listing him as Thesis Advisor for papers authored
by him. This 2026 arXiv entry is research notes with uncertain original manuscript date.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
May apply before finishing bachelor's if completed before matriculation. UChicago math meets degree-type
eligibility. Department expects proof maturity, algebra, linear algebra and rigorous analysis. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Request English waiver by email; arrange three referees, complete draft documents before requesting fee
waiver. Prior adviser agreement not required. [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No PhD program requires securing adviser before applying/admission. Outreach to relevant faculty
encouraged; math program: gradprogram@math.rochester.edu. [s1] [s3]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
apply.grad.rochester.edu, linked from official math page. Public FAQ covers referee upload and additional
documents. [s1] [s3]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
Official math page has not explicitly rolled forward from Fall 2026.2027 deadline, stipend and tests must be
confirmed. [s1]

Academic application [Prior cycle]
Department explicitly gives January 5, 2026 for Fall 2026; general graduate page lists January 5 without year.
Fall 2027 exact deadline and cutoff timezone are not verified. [s1] [s2]

Merit-based awards made through academic department during admissions; no separate math funding
deadline found.2027 application date requires confirmation. [s4]

All materials, including letters, must reach application by program deadline. Current 2027 date unverified; last
explicit math deadline January 5, 2026. [s1] [s2]

No binding program-wide acceptance deadline for Fall 2027 was established in the public admissions pages
checked. Use the individual offer and ask the program if unclear; do not infer April 15 merely from an earlier
CGS signatory list. [s1] [s2] [s3]
English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
General school accepts TOEFL/iBT Home, IELTS, Duolingo. Department old page states TOEFL 100 with
speaking 21. Two-year validity at application deadline. Ask for updated TOEFL-scale math minimum if testing is
needed. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Possible after at least 3 years full-time in-person postsecondary study in US/eligible country. Email
graduate.admissions@rochester.edu to request; university may still require proof. [s2]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Department checklist says GRE scores but only explicitly discusses optional math subject test. General-test
status is unclear; obtain confirmation. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Prior cycle]
Strongly encouraged, not required, on department page currently carrying Fall 2026 date. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload official or unofficial transcript copies at application; official final transcript/degree after acceptance. [s1]
[s3]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
The public admissions checklist checked does not establish a separate mathematics course-list requirement.
Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited uploads are
permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]

requirement. Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited
uploads are permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three. Additional letters only with department permission. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s1] [s2] [s3]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Enter referee details in application; system sends upload link. Exact save-versus-send click is not specified. [s2]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, letters can follow applicant submission, but cannot miss the program deadline. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Application status page is provided to check receipt of all required materials. [s2]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Submitted application cannot be edited, but additional documents may be uploaded. Letter
replacement/prior-cycle reuse not established. [s3]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload; summarize education, research, work, publications/presentations, skills and honors. No page
limit stated; clean consistent format advised. [s1] [s2]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required upload, maximum 500 words. General prompt paraphrase: professional goals, academic interests,
preparation experiences and specific program/faculty fit. Math-specific exact wording and file rules unverified.
[s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Course-list document; Scholarship essays; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Address academic/research interests in SOP; no separate required document verified. [s2]
Publications list [Unresolved]
Include publications/presentations in CV if applicable; separate list or full-paper upload/link not specified. [s2]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Math page currently states USD 26,000 for 9 months of TA service, about 10 hours/week, plus tuition waiver
and mandatory health fee. Summer teaching roughly USD 5,000 competitively available. Page is not a verified
2027 rate; do not treat summer as guaranteed. [s1]
Years of support [Prior cycle]
Department states at least 4 years in good standing; fifth year typically available with satisfactory
progress.2027 contract controls. [s1]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department explicitly describes incoming foreign students receiving stipend while initially assigned grading
pending spoken-English evaluation. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Good standing/progress and assigned TA/grading service; teaching duties depend on spoken-English
evaluation. [s1]

Department awards merit support during admission; no separate application established. [s4]

Competitive summer teaching and adviser summer research fellowships; advanced Dean's Teaching
Fellowships also described, with dated/undated amounts requiring confirmation. [s1]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
USD 70 nonrefundable on department page carrying Fall 2026 date; verify current portal. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Request in application; central FAQ says case-by-case after all required materials are complete, via
departmental coordinator. [s1] [s3]

Central school allows degree/study-based English waiver and several exams; older math page says TOEFL

Ask math program for 2027 exact deadline, General GRE policy, stipend/guarantee and summer rate, missing
